Name: Bold and Brash - Content Patcher
Author: 7thAxis
Description:
🖌️Adds the Bold and Brash painting from Spongebob as a 2x2 object via Content Patcher! 

💲You may purchase the painting from Robin for 100G, or you can get it from the furniture catalogue.

❗This mod was originally created by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Cedarwood7916?gameId=1303]Cedarwood7916[/url], and a Content Patcher conversion was requested on [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/StardewValleyMods/comments/1l5ohln/_/?post_fullname=t3_1l5ohln&post_index=0]Reddit[/url].
